test_title: PYST 32: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Sanju has a family of eight members. Binodh is the eldest male member of the family and is married to Narmada. Hayati is the daughter of Narmada and the sister -in-law of Suvid and Alekya. Apart from Sanju and Binodh, Suvid is the only male member of the family. Alekya is the aunt of Sanju's two daughters, Sarayu and Dakshi. How is Dakshi related to Suvid's brother?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44527c1281447f7cac6b2e90be4f1445976f914d8dd02d9ec03440778cdfc236.png] 

1) Binod is the eldest male member of the family and is married to Narmada.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c24d687a68ffb61d7a98d1c32e5a6ec654f4a540a9ec279aeefd2bc9024122f.png] 

2) Hayati is the daughter of Narmada and sister-in-law of Suvid and Alekya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc79b7e8551ca464ef3a5d00c56cfd0b085f5d394aa829a32f49b80979cc6334.png] 

3) Apart from Sanju and Binodh, Suvid is the only male member of the family.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5565e8682e3d6438eb8d57f9a35410901e373ada23ab715fef79e65052213089.png] 

4) Alekya is the aunt of Sanju's two daughters, Sarayu and Dakshi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40e3cb89b6df4d33b1bd5622c54774de0877c97552cad6263b7f7cf6b9b46ce6.png] 

Clearly, we can see that **Dakshi is Daughter of Suvid's brother"**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Daughter".**
